remarks: Welcome to 160 Glenbrook Road, Unit 3B, a spacious three-bedroom, three-and-a-half-bath townhouse-style condominium in Stamford's desirable Glenbrook neighborhood. This approximately 1,856-square-foot home offers a flexible three-level layout, hardwood flooring, abundant natural light, and an attached two-car garage. The main level features an inviting dining and living area with custom built-in cabinetry, a well-appointed kitchen with stainless steel appliances, and a convenient half bath. The upper levels offer generously sized bedrooms, full baths, and versatile space for a home office, guest area, or additional living space. This unit was built for the builders daughter, so it has 2 separate primary suites! This is accompanied by a convenient balcony, and 2 car garage + storage room. Located close to shopping, restaurants, public transportation, the train station, parks, and other amenities, this home offers comfortable living in a convenient Stamford location. Don't miss this opportunity to make 160 Glenbrook Road your new home!
